		add_government_reform = jxp_a_96_buddhist_mountain_council_reform
		change_government_reform_progress = 50
	}
	option = {
		name = "jxp_buddhist_state.200.c"
		jxp_a_96_choose_buddhist_finale_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = jxp_a_buddhist_final_clerical_temporal
		add_government_reform = jxp_a_96_buddhist_clerical_temporal_reform
		change_government_reform_progress = 50
	}
}
